function: Excluded, system (p. 3): over-the-air FL aggregation (area 7) over scalar channels h_{m,k} ~ CN(0,1) between single-antenna devices and a single-antenna parameter server; no RIS.
notes: Reason system, p. 3, eq. (4): y_m = sum_k h_{m,k} beta_k rho_{m,k} g_m^k + z, "where h_{m,k} ~ CN(0, 1) is the small-scale fading between the PS and device k". By the paper's notation (p. 3: "Boldface lowercase (uppercase) letters represent vectors (matrices)"), h_{m,k} is a non-bold scalar, so each device and the PS have one antenna; y_m and z are vectors only because the gradient is d-dimensional. p. 4, eq. (5) inverts this scalar channel in the pre-processing factor. No RIS in the system: RIS and beamforming appear only in related work ([17], [22], [23]), and the simulation setup on p. 10 (K = 40, M = 6, Pmax = 0 dBm) gives no antenna count. Earlier codes do not apply: research article (JSAC); FL over the air passes no_learning; the clustering and weighting-factor design for hierarchical analog AirComp with robust aggregation is the over-the-air aggregation itself (p. 10: "confined to the physical layer"), so it is area 7, which code 6 covers. PDF is arXiv 2503.18284v1; its title and six authors match the Crossref record of the DOI (IEEE JSAC vol. 43, no. 6, pp. 1954-1969).
